item.title: US proposes rule to revise H-1B, PERM wage calculations, may impact Indian workers
item.description: The US Department of Labor has proposed changes to H-1B and PERM wage rules that may raise salary thresholds and affect Indian workers and US employers.

item.title: Centre to launch nationwide single-dose HPV vaccination drive for 14-year-old girls
item.description: Government to provide free, voluntary Gardasil-4 shots at public health facilities in line with WHO recommendations to curb cervical cancer burden in India

item.title: Super 8, Ind vs Zim preview: A must-win T20 WC game for India in Chennai
item.description: Winning this contest by a big margin is critical to India's existence in the ICC showpiece given the beating their net run rate (-3.80) took after the 76-run defeat to South Africa on Sunday

item.title: How Bengal worker’s death in Pune turns focus on migrants' lives across India
item.description: The 'targeting' of workers from West Bengal, allegedly over suspicions of being illegal Bangladeshi immigrants, is only the latest in a long narrative of discrimination, ridicule and at times, assault that migrants from across states have had to face for years.

item.title: Sikh man killed in US: Authorities say he wasn’t intended target
item.description: Avtar Singh, a volunteer in Sikh temple, was last seen alive entering a white SUV with three men who allegedly forced him inside against his will

item.title: SC on NCERT's 'corruption in judiciary' chapter: ‘Will not allow institution to be defamed’
item.description: Corruption, massive backlog of cases, and lack of an adequate number of judges are among the "challenges" faced by the judicial system, according to the new social science NCERT textbook for Class 8

item.title: Water contamination in Andhra: One dead, over 70 hospitalised in Srikakulam
item.description: According to the DMHO, door-to-door health screening is currently underway in the affected area, and immediate treatment is being provided on the spot for minor cases
